HAHS.description: Heat of Hydration Loads (HAHS). Assigns a heat source to an element by referencing a Heat Source Function (HSFC) by name; the referenced function name must already exist in the model.

FUNC_NAME.description: Name of the Heat Source Function (HSFC) to assign. Must match an existing HSFC name in the model; an empty string clears the reference. A non-empty name that does not resolve to an existing function is rejected.
